title: Connplex Zoning Studio — Rules & Config Registry
description: Central, versioned, source-backed rule/catalogue data. Application and layout-engine code must read these values, never hardcode them (Master Context Product Principle #1 / §74-75). Every value below carries an approval_status; only DECIDED / SOURCE_BACKED entries may act as production hard constraints. ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION entries are clearly marked and must not be silently promoted.

planning_norms.description: First-row distance >= screen width. Requires a screen_width input not yet captured by intake — cannot be evaluated numerically until that field exists.
Wall-to-seat side clearance used by the v1 seat-packing estimator. NOT stated explicitly in the SOP extract available to this project.
Rear circulation clearance used by the v1 seat-packing estimator. NOT stated explicitly in the SOP extract available to this project.

Minimum share of a region's usable area (after auditoriums) the v1 auto-layout keeps as genuine circulation rather than growing support zones (foyer/F&B/washroom/box office/BOH) into it. No SOP-stated circulation percentage exists for this pipeline; set from what a well-packed real floor plate looks like, not a claim of company policy.

Cap on how far a support zone's target area may grow past its formulaic target (see SUPPORT_ZONE_CIRCULATION_RESERVE_RATIO) when real leftover usable area is available, so no single zone balloons past what's architecturally plausible.
Foyer at main entry level must include these functions.

planning_norms.description: Qualitative adjacency rule, not yet machine-checkable without a sightline model.

planning_norms.value: visible from entry; adequate circulation; plumbing lines available
no cross-movement between entry/exit flows; separate entry & exit flow per auditorium; direct fire-exit access from circulation

planning_norms.description: Measurable proxy threshold for SEPARATE_ENTRY_EXIT_FLOW's qualitative 'no cross-movement between entry/exit flows' rule: the straight-line distance below which a marked exit point is flagged as not clearly separated from the main entrance. The SOP states the qualitative rule but no specific distance; this is v1's own line-of-sight substitute for real circulation-path routing (which this engine does not model), so a warning, never a hard block, and revisable once real adjacency/path data exists.
